RULE-BASED RECOMMENDATIONS

Suggested validation plan

Recommendations are hypotheses until tested against real operational results.

1. Establish a baseline

Record the current issue rate, rating, waiting time, stock-out rate or other relevant measure.

2. Run a small pilot

Test one change in one team, location or channel before rolling it out widely.

3. Compare the outcome

Use the same measure after the change and keep, revise or stop the intervention based on evidence.

Combined dataset preview

Rows and columns in the current dataset

Privacy and accuracy: Files are processed locally in your browser. This webpage does not send your dataset to an AI service or a server. Uploaded data is held in browser memory only and is cleared when you reload or close the page. Excel reading uses a spreadsheet library loaded from a public CDN; the data itself stays in the browser.

What happens when you upload?

  1. The app reads the first worksheet of each Excel file or the contents of each CSV.
  2. Rows are appended to the combined dataset. Columns are aligned by their header names.
  3. Column names and values are checked to identify numeric ratings, recommendation scores, issue categories, segments and feedback text.
  4. The dashboard recalculates KPIs, group comparisons and issue frequencies using the newly combined rows.
  5. A transparent recommendation library connects detected issue themes to practical actions and measurable outcomes.

What the analysis can and cannot do

  • It can summarise numeric columns, compare segments, count issue categories and detect common feedback themes.
  • It can suggest relevant actions using transparent rules and issue keywords.
  • It cannot prove causation, verify that a recommendation will work or understand every business context.
  • It is not an autonomous AI agent. Generative AI recommendations would require a separately configured model/API and appropriate data protection controls.
  • For best results, use consistent column names and one row per observation / customer response.

Supported file and column types

Files

CSV, XLSX and XLS. Multiple files can be added one after another.

Common fields

Satisfaction, ratings, NPS / recommendation scores, issue, complaint, feedback, store, region, channel, date and return intent.

Outputs

Dashboard, issue analysis, suggested actions, combined CSV and action-plan CSV.
